title: Rainbow Mountain Full-Day Tour
short_description: Discover the famous Rainbow Mountain, or Vinicunca, on a full-day excursion from Cusco surrounded by spectacular Andean scenery and views of Ausangate.
long_description:
Experience an unforgettable adventure to Rainbow Mountain, also known as Vinicunca, one of Cusco's most impressive natural landscapes.

During this full-day excursion from Cusco, you will travel through high-Andean scenery, local communities and natural settings dominated by majestic Ausangate.

After hiking through the Andes, we will reach the Vinicunca viewpoint, where you can admire the characteristic red, yellow and turquoise tones created by the mountain's mineral composition.

An ideal experience for travelers who love nature, adventure, trekking and photography.

days.title: Day 1: Cusco – Rainbow Mountain – Cusco
days.text:
Our adventure begins very early with pickup from your hotel in Cusco. We will travel south while enjoying the sunrise and impressive Andean scenery.

We will stop for a traditional breakfast before continuing to the starting point of our hike.

We begin the ascent to Rainbow Mountain – Vinicunca. Along the trail, we may see llamas, alpacas, local communities and spectacular views of Ausangate.

At the viewpoint, we will admire one of Cusco's most remarkable natural landscapes. There will be time for photographs, to enjoy the scenery and to learn about the mountain and its surroundings from our guide.

We then descend to our transportation and enjoy a buffet lunch before returning to Cusco.

faq.respuesta: Vinicunca is located in the Cusco Region of the Peruvian Andes, near Ausangate.

faq.pregunta: What is the altitude of Rainbow Mountain?
faq.respuesta: The viewpoint is approximately 5,100 meters above sea level, so prior acclimatization in Cusco is recommended.

faq.pregunta: How long does the tour take?
faq.respuesta: It is a full-day excursion that begins very early in Cusco and returns in the afternoon.
The hike is moderate to difficult, mainly because of the altitude. Take it slowly and acclimatize beforehand.
